summary: Frontend-only test of /download page redirect + store button behavior. All 6 scenarios PASSED: (1) Desktop stays on /download, no redirect. (2) app-store-btn href = https://apps.apple.com/in/app/intownlocal/id6766092424. (3) play-store-btn href = https://play.google.com/store/search?q=intown&c=apps&hl=en_IN. (4) iOS UA emulation triggers window.location.replace to Apple App Store (verified via request interception - 2 hits to apps.apple.com/in/app/intownlocal/id6766092424). (5) Android UA emulation redirects to Play Store URL (page.url ended at play.google.com/store/search?q=intown&c=apps&hl=en_IN). (6) cta-download-btn href = Play Store URL on desktop; onClick handler swaps to OS store on mobile (code-verified via getMobileStoreUrl).
critical_code_review_comments: Download.js: cta-download-btn uses window.location.href in onClick but useEffect uses window.location.replace — minor inconsistency but not a bug.
download-store-icon for App Store button has empty content (blank span) — visually only the Google Play icon shows an arrow. Consider adding an Apple logo/icon for symmetry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified /download redirect logic via Playwright with custom iOS and Android user agents. For iOS, external nav to apps.apple.com may show final url as chrome-error or /download depending on network — use page.route interception to reliably confirm the redirect URL was requested.
